verses.32: And what more can I say? Time will surely bring out the stories about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
verses.33: Those who accused the kingdom of being unjust, sought justice. They succeeded in their claims, and made people listen to their words.
verses.34: The power of fire was destroyed; the mouths of swords were sealed. They became strong again from their weakness. They became warriors in battle, able to defeat many enemies.
verses.35: We took the women from the area of Anastasis to take care of their dead. Others, however, were upset; they didn’t want to participate in this burial ceremony, so that those who died during Anastasis could be honored properly.
verses.36: Others, on the other hand, were subjected to punishment and humiliation; they also suffered from bonds and imprisonment.
verses.37: They were killed in a sword attack. They died in violent deaths. They were buried in muddy ground, covered with dirty skin. They suffered greatly, were in great pain, and were filled with sorrow.
verses.38: Who was not worthy of being rewarded by the world, those who wandered through deserts, mountains, caves, and the depths of the earth?
verses.39: And all those who testified because of their faith did not accept this message.
verses.40: The Lord has planned something for us, so that we won’t be left alone when it’s all over.
